name: Visual Check
description: Gate checker. Decides whether this project has visual regression tooling of its own - Playwright or Cypress snapshots, Storybook test-runner, Percy, Chromatic, Loki - and names the command that runs it against its committed baselines. Atlas runs it; a real pixel diff routes to the Visual Reviewer, which can look at the images. Atlas ships no screenshot harness of its own.
summary: Finds this project's own screenshot or visual-regression command, or says it has none.
